fieldValues.title: Too many flags make the check ignorable
fieldValues.statement: A cautious process flags freely: about half of its precedent checks come back as in tension with a standing record. Shown all of them, a secretary stops reading them, and the one flag that matters (a job over the spending limit) is lost among the rest.
source_ref: srs-programme source-documents/governance-minutes-2026-11-27/srs-minutes-project.md: 89 checks over two meetings, about half in tension
